details:
Q1. What exactly should be improved?
Choices:
A. A failing workflow or helper script — reply with the workflow/job/run link or the exact file/path. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A documentation/operator-guidance problem — reply with the doc path/topic and what is unclear.
C. A specific existing behavior in the repo — reply with the component/file and the desired before/after behavior.
Q2. What scope should planning assume once that target is identified?
Choices:
A. Smallest safe local change only. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Small related change across a few files in the same subsystem.
C. Broader cross-workflow/refactor-level change is acceptable if needed.
